name: Raúl Benavides
bio:
Raúl's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by watching rally races in the rugged terrain of his hometown near the Andes. Lacking formal training initially, he honed his mechanical skills by tinkering with his grandfather's old pickup truck, learning the intricacies of engines and fabrication through trial and error. Recognizing his potential, a local racing team offered him an entry-level position, where he quickly absorbed knowledge from experienced machinists, specializing in precision component manufacturing.

Raúl approaches his work with a practical and meticulous mindset, valuing efficiency and reliability above all else. He is driven by a desire to master the art of precision machining, constantly seeking opportunities to refine his techniques and expand his knowledge of advanced materials. While still developing his management and innovation skills, Raúl's unwavering commitment to quality and his natural aptitude for problem-solving make him a valuable asset to any team. He dreams of one day crafting engine components that will power a Chilean driver to victory on the world stage.

Though quiet and reserved, Raúl's dedication is unmistakable. He believes in letting his work speak for itself, striving for perfection in every task he undertakes. His goal is to become the best damn machinist in South America, one perfectly-tooled part at a time.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Raúl is of average height and build, with calloused hands that speak to his hours spent working with machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Refuses to listen to music while working, claiming it distracts him from precise measurements.
Has a habit of double-checking torque specifications, even for routine tasks.
